title: 큰 차수 선출고의 날짜 분배·재고 조정쌍·업로드 절대수량 통합 계약

calendar.ui: Major cycles only; explicit actual source date
calendar.anchors: Server resolves first validated actual business subweek per major cycle using calendar and existing business-key evidence; never fabricate suffix or cycle53
calendar.dateWrite: Actual date business key is separate from source stock anchor
calendar.crossYear: Chronological next major cycle from real calendar, not arithmetic week increment

record.storage: New transactional MSSQL linked ledger, schema migration required before implementation
record.failure: ROLLED_BACK response guarantees zero committed business effects; no durable partially applied success
record.idempotency: Same UUID/hash replays result; changed hash conflicts409; revisions require CAS

tableEffects.OrderMaster_OrderDetail: ADD creates positive order only when current-year active order absent; existing order and all CANCEL orders preserved; never zero fake order
tableEffects.ShipmentMaster_ShipmentDetail_ShipmentDa: Only validated source dated allocation and associated native pricing/history/fix lifecycle
tableEffects.StockHistory: Linked append-only native-compatible adjustment pair and native shipment lifecycle histories
tableEffects.Product: Locked live Stock reconciled to native adjustment/fixed shipment deltas; SP snapshot calculation is not assumed to update live Stock
tableEffects.StockMaster_ProductStock: Native anchor materialization and earliest-source cascade including future years; no future-snapshot existence preblock
tableEffects.Estimate_WebProfitReport: No direct writes; verify native estimate visibility DetailFix and fixed sales downstream
tableEffects.WebLinkedLedger: New atomic operation/revision/effect audit; legacy notes remain informational

transaction.provider: One tQ executor under one withTransaction; no independently committing HTTP API chain
sequence: gate owner V2 before business locks
linked operation reservation and ordered source/target leases
trusted beforePrepare source +q after engine reserve/source lease but before preparePlans
single engine absolute allocation/fix lifecycle and intermediate stock checks
target -q adjustment in same outer tQ
materialize target anchor if required and cascade from earliest source
outer native output checks and all future negative snapshot rollback
transaction.reuse: Single engine plus trusted server-only hook or refactored pure provider; default modes unchanged. Never blindly invoke engine twice, put both stock effects before availability check, or copy stock-adjust historical snapshot blocker
transaction.replay: Linked APPLIED result replays without hook. Engine-only audit without linked ledger conflicts; inner successful audit is not committed until outer pair/readback completes
transaction.finalGuard: Inner future stock guard precedes target minus and is insufficient: outer full affected future/current snapshot negative check is mandatory

units: Finite positive exact normalized quantities; verified conversion coefficients; decimal computation with native ROUND(2) readback; no silent precision loss or UNKNOWN/NULL as zero

upload.selection: Only APPLIED unreversed effects matching exact targetYear/targetMajorWeek/customer/product/unit
upload.formula: finalTarget = originalTotal - earlyExcludedApplied; delta = finalTarget - existingTarget
upload.forbidden: Do not store originalTotal-processedEarly-existingTarget as final target; do not subtract twice across suffix rows, repeated preview, legacy notes or already-excluded source files
upload.provenance: Explicit ORIGINAL_INCLUDES_EARLY default versus ALREADY_EXCLUDED. Manual unmatched early-column exclusion means already excluded when validated; trusted raw excluded quantity is informational only, not processed ledger
upload.excludeOnce: Server stores deterministic targetImportYear/week from first validated target anchor. earlyExcludedApplied=processedEarlyTotal only in ORIGINAL_INCLUDES_EARLY and exact selected upload year/week matches anchor; other suffix weeks or ALREADY_EXCLUDED apply0 and show reason plus processed total. Reuploads recompute from original, not a consumed balance
upload.ambiguous: Major total with multiple suffix buckets or early quantity in nonanchor bucket requires explicit provenance and mapping; block if unknown, no automatic ratios or moving original quantities

confirmation: Explicit user button; preserve originally fixed scopes via proven native lifecycle, never auto-confirm unfixed rows; rollback pair/allocation on any native cancel/fix/recalc error
negativeStock: Reject actual negative current/future affected snapshots after native calculation; do not fabricate shortage adjustments without explicit separately confirmed user action
classification: q<=finalsourceDateQuantity and cumulative active classifiedq<=same finaldate quantity; record marked-existing versus actual saved allocation delta. Source UI remainder adds classifiedq to existing basis without mutating immutable baseline

ui.scroll: Page primary vertical scroll; horizontal business table exception
ui.keyboard: Tab/Shift+Tab Enter/Space Escape arrows and modal focus restoration

externalWrites: Design author performs none; main alone handles schema/deployment/operational writes after required verification

actionPolicy.PREVIEW: SELECT only; does not register legacy page notes as processed shipments
actionPolicy.APPLY: Source actual date is absolute final target, not existing+classifiedq; existing allocation classification permits no-op. Source adjustment +q then engine allocation then target adjustment -q in one outer transaction
actionPolicy.REVERSE: Cancel classification with append-only compensating stock pair; preserve all source allocation including APPLY_ABSOLUTE. Allocation cancellation uses existing dated ALLOCATION workflow separately.

crossYearFixture.rule: same major different year is isolated; calendar next major can cross year

dnspyEvidence.source: Actual installed Nenova.exe dnSpy CLI FormStockAdd/ClassStockHistory and current read-only MSSQL same-key probe 2026-10-08
